statement.p: A new water heater for your home is will cost {\$800.00} to buy and have installed. With this new more efficient water heater, your monthly gas bill will be (on average) {\$20.00}\text{.} According to this information, the equation y={800+20x} models the total expense from heating your domestic hot water after x months, where y is in dollars. Make a graph of this equation.
